name: MBKAuthe
tagline: Modern, developer-first authentication & authorization engine for Node.js and Express
description: MBKAuthe is an enterprise-grade authentication and authorization framework for Node.js and Express, built with TypeScript ESM. Features dual-database persistence (PostgreSQL & SQLite), encrypted multi-session management, dynamic manifest-driven RBAC & permissions, cryptographic TokenEngine, RFC 8628 CLI device login, OAuth social authentication, domain event streaming, and resilient database retries.
author: Muhammad Bin Khalid

keyFeatures.title: Dual-Database Resilience
keyFeatures.description: Production PostgreSQL connection pooling alongside fast embedded SQLite (via better-sqlite3 with WAL mode and FIFO Mutex). Includes dialect translation, query retry with exponential backoff, and live query logging.

keyFeatures.title: Encrypted Multi-Session Engine
keyFeatures.description: Encrypted session cookies, automatic database validation, session restoration middleware, multi-account device tracking, and automatic concurrent session pruning (MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER).

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Manifest-Driven RBAC
keyFeatures.description: Fine-grained permissions defined via declarative manifests (definePermissions, syncAppPermissions). Features RoleRegistry, wildcard matching, and drop-in middleware (sessVal, sessRole, sessPerm, roleChk, permChk).

keyFeatures.title: Cryptographic TokenEngine
keyFeatures.description: Cryptographically secure prefixed tokens (mbk_pat_, mbk_cli_, mbk_dev_, mbk_sess_) with constant-time SHA-256 validation, scoped permissions, and last-used tracking.

keyFeatures.title: RFC 8628 CLI Device Login
keyFeatures.description: Standards-compliant OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant allowing command-line tools to authenticate seamlessly via the browser with 8-character user codes.

keyFeatures.title: Domain Events & Diagnostics
keyFeatures.description: Type-safe domain event emitter (authEvents) for login, logout, token creation, and CLI approvals, paired with real-time health diagnostics (getAuthHealthReport).

securityHighlights.title: Salt + Pepper Password Hashing
securityHighlights.description: Cryptographically secure password hashing using Node.js crypto PBKDF2/Argon2id hybrid mechanics with unique per-user salts and global server pepper.

securityHighlights.title: Constant-Time Token Verification
securityHighlights.description: All API tokens, device tokens, and session secrets are verified using crypto.timingSafeEqual to eliminate timing side-channel attacks.

securityHighlights.title: Encrypted Session Cookies
securityHighlights.description: Session identifiers are encrypted on the client side to protect against tampering and network inspection.

securityHighlights.title: Built-in Security Middleware
securityHighlights.description: Includes automated security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), strict CORS negotiation, CSRF protection, and rate limiting.

securityHighlights.title: Automatic Session Eviction
securityHighlights.description: Enforces MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER by automatically pruning the oldest active sessions upon new logins.

securityHighlights.title: Resilient Database Retries
securityHighlights.description: Transparent query retries with exponential backoff and jitter for transient connection errors, timeouts, and SQLite locks.
